There are those concepts, however, whose reality is debatable, even to the SCP Foundation, begging them to ask the question of what, exactly, is real.

glosses: The real world.

examples.text: A man very often fancies that he understands a critic, when in reality he does not comprehend his meaning.

glosses: A real entity, event, or other fact.
